# DMX — current quests, October 16, 2026

DMX is an internal cumulative points system. Buying, exchanging and withdrawing points are not implemented. Repeated checks, restarts and unlinking game IDs cannot duplicate a reward. Previously issued awards keep their original amounts when rules change.

Subscribe to [@DMX_Core](https://t.me/DMX_Core) for 100 DMX once per Telegram account, without a loadout bonus or game link. Opening the channel is not proof of membership. Bot administrator status and live member lookup were verified on October 16. Tap Check subscription to verify membership and collect the one-time reward.

## DMX in the game nickname

Add Latin DMX to your Pixel World nickname for **50 DMX once per game UID**, without a loadout bonus. Matching is case insensitive and existing eligible names count. A linked UID and a fresh nickname verified through the game API are required; Telegram names and saved display names are not proof. Check nickname refreshes the game data. Renaming, unlinking, repeated checks and restarts cannot issue the reward again. All one-time quests are excluded from equipment bonuses.

## Battle ladders

Each map battle awards 10 / 25 / 50 DMX cumulatively at 1,000 / 2,000 / 3,000 personal points. A full owned equipped loadout gives 15 / 37 / 75 cumulatively. Repeatable game quests receive the loadout bonus (+10% per owned equipped item, maximum +50%); one-time rewards stay fixed at 100 DMX for subscription and 50 DMX for the game nickname. Each standalone quest reward is rounded down to whole DMX. Already paid quests keep their original amounts without top-ups. The server rechecks ownership through NotGames. New battles repeat eligibility with no daily cap; changing equipment cannot repay a completed stage.

## Nine daily quests

| Distinct maps | 1,000 each | 2,000 each | 3,000 each |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 2 | 5 DMX | 10 DMX | 15 DMX |
| 3 | 10 DMX | 25 DMX | 50 DMX |
| 5 | 25 DMX | 50 DMX | 75 DMX |

All nine quests are available together. Each reward pays separately once daily, up to 265 DMX without a loadout or 395 with a full loadout. At +50%, individual rewards of 5 / 25 / 75 become 7 / 37 / 112 DMX. Each map must meet its point threshold in a single battle for the same clan. Repeating a map does not add distinct maps; separate low-scoring battles and different clans do not combine to fill a goal. A saved daily-rule release timestamp prevents retroactive awards for the retired Two Fronts rotation. Old payments remain intact.

## Weekly quests

| Quest | Requirement | Reward |
|---|---|---:|
| Weekly Route | 1,000 points on each of 5 / 10 distinct maps during the week | 100 / 250 DMX total |
| Major Contribution | 10,000 personal points during the week | 250 DMX |
| Major Effort | 25,000 personal points during the week | 500 DMX |

Weekly Route pays 100 at five maps and another 150 at ten. The 10,000 and 25,000 quests are independent: both can be earned in the same week for 750 combined. All weekly rewards together total up to 1,000 DMX without a loadout or 1,500 with a full loadout. At +50%, the route pays 150 + 225 = 375, the 10k quest pays 375 and the separate 25k quest pays 750 DMX.

Days begin at 00:00 UTC and weeks on Monday at 00:00 UTC (05:00 in Yekaterinburg). Periods use the battle's end time. Delayed rewards stay assigned to the original period.

## Victories

The winning clan's top five registered DMX contributors with at least 1,000 personal points receive 100 DMX each on Boxes, Panelka and City; all other maps award 50 DMX each before equipment bonuses (150 / 75 DMX with a full loadout). Ties use ascending Telegram ID. Rankings are frozen 5 minutes 30 seconds after completion from safely observed contributions, not reconstructed full game history. A final single winner and matching post-battle ownership are required.

Any confirmed capture/defense with at least 1,000 personal points also gives 10 DMX without equipment or 15 with a full loadout, regardless of top-five position. This combines with the top-five reward. Territory counters remain available in profiles.

## Tracking and budget

Additional quests count verified contributions in battles completed after launch; settlement starts 5 minutes 30 seconds after completion. Unknown past contributions, monitoring gaps and ambiguous overlapping battles do not manufacture points. All awards are recorded in the same persistent ledger.

For N complete ladders, W eligible victories and M total top-five map awards: 50N + 10W + M without equipment, or 75N + 15W + 1.5M with a full loadout. Winning top-five members completing the ladder receive 160 / 240 on Boxes, Panelka and City, or 110 / 165 on other maps (without / with a full loadout).

An illustrative full pass through 11 maps with victories and top-five placement gives 1,360 / 2,040 before daily and weekly goals: base map awards sum to 700 (1,050 with a full loadout). Seven full days of daily goals add up to 1,855 / 2,765 and weekly quests another 1,000 / 1,500, totaling 2,855 / 4,265 without / with a full loadout beyond battle rewards. One-time quests add 100 for subscription and 50 for the game nickname, without equipment bonuses. There is no overall battle cap, and spending mechanics are not implemented yet.

Medals have been removed and new medal payments disabled; historical awards remain. Social rewards have no clan attribution. Battle wins belong to their battle's clan; other game awards go to a recently confirmed current clan when available. Existing clan scores do not move with players. Clan ownership funds and tournament awards remain disabled.

A match entered just before map entry closes may finish up to four minutes later. When a roster-score increase can belong to both the old and new map, it is saved in a separate pending journal and cannot unlock map rewards. This aggregate source cannot resolve its exact map automatically. An isolated late finish with only one eligible battle remains with that battle. Final scores and top-five rankings wait 5 minutes 30 seconds after entry closes.
